title: Saudi Arabian Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice dish originating from Saudi Arabia, often served with meat or vegetables.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the long-grain rice and stir to coat with the oil.
Add the pilaf and stir to combine with the rice.
Add the peas and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pour in enough water to cover the rice mixture and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
